title: Array Sum
statementMd:
You are given an array of integers. Calculate the sum of its elements.

## Input

The $*i*$-th line of the input contains an integer $*a*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *a* ≤ 1000$) — the $*i*$-th element of the array. The size of the array is between 1 and 10, inclusive. Note that the size of the array is not given explicitly!

## Output

Output a single integer — the sum of the elements of the array.
